description:
You and your lone comrade, the only two operatives close enough to exploit this critical moment, stand at a crossroads after intercepting enemy communications detailing a vulnerable, high-value target deep behind their lines. A synchronized, all-out assault on this objective promises a strategic victory that could cripple their entire offensive, but if only one of you commits to such a bold strike, they will be utterly sacrificed with no impact while the other safely secures local, smaller gains. The alternative is for both of you to individually consolidate positions and scavenge for vital resources in safer territory, ensuring mutual survival and modest tactical advantages, albeit foregoing the chance for a war-winning breakthrough.

Option A: Push for the main objective.
Option B: Secure local resources.

meta.rules_ref: Two players (potential partners, not adversaries) simultaneously choose to Hunt Stag (cooperative, high reward) or Hunt Hare (safe, individual). Hunting Stag requires both players to coordinate — it only succeeds if both commit. Payoffs: Mutual Stag = 4 points each (the best shared outcome). Mutual Hare = 3 points each. If one hunts Stag alone while the other hunts Hare, the Stag hunter gets 0 points (the attempt fails without a partner) and the Hare hunter still gets 3 points. The core tension is trust: both players benefit most from cooperating, but each risks everything if the other plays it safe. Action_A represents Hunting Stag. Action_B represents Hunting Hare.
